rv.q: Director Frederique Michel draws well-calibrated performances from the cast, and again reveals her knack for evocative, 'creative atmosphere-ing.'
It's all très charmant (but also très talky), which is why audiences will thank producer Charles A. Duncombe and director Frédérique Michel for having given Mee's original script a trim.
All three performances are as quietly glorious as a perfect haiku, or maybe a simple but exquisite bouquet of flowers.
